title: Abeon Stored Object
description: One file in the organisation's object container (ADR-0021 as amended by ADR-0034). The container belongs to the organisation; the `{service}/{visibility}/` prefix inside it belongs to one application, and a signature issued for one prefix opens nothing outside it.

key.description: Full path inside the container: `{service}/{visibility}/{path}`. Every segment starts with an alphanumeric, which is what makes `..` and hidden segments unrepresentable rather than merely discouraged.

service.description: The application that owns the object. The first segment of `key`, and taken from the caller's service token — never from the request body.

visibility.description: `public` is readable by anyone at `url`, because the container policy allows anonymous GET under `*/public/*` and nowhere else. `private` is readable only through a short-lived signed URL.

size.description: Bytes, when the storage reported them. Null before the upload the signature was issued for has happened.

url.description: The stable public address, for a `public` object. Null for a `private` one: its address is signed per read and expires, so it is not a property of the object.
